Is capacity your #1 constraint right now?

The tell: demand is there and you physically cannot serve it. It's one of the twelve places growth gets stuck — but it's only worth fixing first if it's actually your biggest. Growth Terminal ranks all twelve against your data and tells you whether capacity is really the one, or a symptom of something upstream.

Diagnose your #1 constraint free. Link in bio.
